name: phase7_repaired_tables_v1
author: assistant (Claude); questions and gold written from the LaTeX source tables and the c4 extraction
review_status: pending independent human review; not used for any production decision until reviewed
separate_from: eval/questions.jsonl and eval/answer_quality_set.json (the original evaluation); not merged
symbol_policy: Marks are referred to as printed (✓, ✗, blank). No question asks what a mark means beyond the column it is in; a blank cell is never treated as 'no', false or zero.
evidence_format: gold.rows: one entry per table row the answer needs. id: strings that appear on that row's line in both c3 and c4 (identify the row). cells: strings that must also appear on the same line for the evidence to be complete (marks, values). Matching is on chunk row lines ('Configuration ...') of chunks from the given table. paper_cells (optional): the value as printed in the paper where the corpus text is known to differ; required for the evidence to be correct.
